meta.note: Objects the building has and the Revit model does not, added by the owner per room (objects) or per use for every room of that use in program/rooms.json (by_use, e.g. a desk in every office); the owner's kinds for modelled pieces the family name misnames (rekind, by Revit element id); and the owner's rules for how a room's modelled pieces are used. Keyed by object id; each object names its room (Revit room id), its kind (program/affordances.json), a placement rule, its source and whether its position is inferred. scripts/rasterise.py places them when it builds the tiles (flagged inferred: true there) and the pixel views draw them with an amber mark; exports/ is never changed.

placement.on: opaque_walls: along every wall of the room that is wall or column (not glass, not a door), as a thin surface on the inside face; runs shorter than min_run_m are skipped
placement.wall: <side>, mount: high | shelf | floo: centred on the longest opaque run of that side of the room, width_m wide and depth_m deep against the wall, between bottom_m and top_m
placement.on: object, object: <id>, count, size_m: count pieces spread evenly along the top of that added object
placement.ceiling: true, faces: <side>, distance_m: hung from the ceiling on the centre line of that side's screen, distance_m into the room
placement.corner: north_east | north_west | south_: tucked into the room's open floor at that corner
placement.on: counter, which: west | east | north: on top of that modelled counter of the room, at a fraction along it
placement.box_m: [x0, y0, x1, y1], height_m, z_m: a box in model metres (project base point, +Y project north), the owner's own placement
placement.row_along_wall: <side>, desk_size_m, gap: as many desks as fill the longest run of that side, against the wall, each with a chair on the room side
placement.cluster: n, desk_size_m, chair_size_m: n desks in facing pairs at the centre of the room's main floor, each with a chair
placement.table_set: pairs, table_size_m, chair_si: pairs of the Level 3 crit rooms' 60x90 in tables pushed together at the centre of the room's main floor, chairs round each pair (4 a long side, 1 an end), pairs 1.5 m apart
placement.table_rows: rows_wanted, table_size_m, c: rows of tables across the room facing the room's screen (else the south wall), chairs behind each table, as many rows and tables per row as fit
placement.wall ... along: the along fraction (0 to 1) places a wall piece at that point of the run instead of its middle
placement.ceiling ... screen_object: the projector faces that screen (an object id) when a room has more than one
placement.table_rows ... front: the side the rows face when the room has no screen rule
placement.wc_set: stalls, stall_size_m, sinks, cou: stalls along the longest opaque wall without a door, a counter with sinks along another wall
placement.boxes: [{kind, box_m, height_m, ...}]: a set of pieces of several kinds, each a box in model metres: a hand-laid placeholder
